title: Claimed circulation by language, 2023-24 (self-declared, copies per publishing day) (PRGI)

metadata.vintage: Press Registrar General of India, 'Press in India 2023-24' (as on 31 March 2024).
metadata.note: Circulation is SELF-DECLARED by publishers and explicitly NOT verified by PRGI. 'Registered' is a cumulative stock; of 1,51,474 registered periodicals only 36,358 (~24%) actually filed an annual statement, on which the circulation analysis rests. Treat circulation as indicative and likely inflated.
